subject: SOC2: access evidence mini-collector & delivery plan
messages:
From: Samira Patel <samira@shieldhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: ShieldHealth SOC <soc@shieldhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 evidence request — SSO/SCIM/RBAC (mini-collector)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick intro this week. ShieldHealth is in the middle of our SOC 2 refresh and our auditor has asked for a compact bundle of access-control artifacts focused on SSO, provisioning, and role ownership. We scope this as a "mini-collector" — just enough samples to validate controls rather than a full export.

Specifically we need:
- A 1–2 day SCIM delta extract showing adds/updates/deletes (CSV or JSON) with timestamps and actor identity.
- 3–5 SAML assertion examples (including one for interactive sign-in and one for a service principal/SSO automation flow).
- RBAC owner matrix snapshot (roles -> owner, last modified).
- Provisioning/login event timestamps (a short time-slice log; 1–2 days).

Deadline: could you get this to us within 48 business hours? Our auditor wants to review by EOD Monday. If any of these need redaction, please advise the preferred approach — hashing of user identifiers is fine, but we need consistent mapping.

Also tell us the delivery method you prefer (SFTP, secure Drive link, or HubSpot file drop) and if you need a non-disclosure or any extra paperwork for the auditor.

Appreciate it — let me know if anything here is unclear.

Samira
Samira Patel
Security Assurance Manager, ShieldHealth
samira@shieldhealth.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Samira Patel <samira@shieldhealth.com>
Cc: ShieldHealth SOC <soc@shieldhealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request — SSO/SCIM/RBAC (mini-collector)

Hi Samira — thanks for the clear list. We can put together the mini-collector as requested. Quick plan:

1) We will produce: a 48-hour SCIM delta sample, 4 SAML assertion examples, an RBAC owner matrix (.xlsx), and a 24–48 hour provisioning/login timeslice.
2) Redaction: we will hash PII/UIDs with a salt and include a short mapping note so your auditor can validate consistency without revealing identities.
3) Delivery: secure Drive link (shared view-only) + a hashed index CSV. If you prefer SFTP, we can arrange it.
4) ETA: initial bundle by Mon 2028-07-22 17:00 EDT (within your requested window). If you need earlier, tell us which artifact to prioritize.

Jonas and Marcus — can you own collection and redaction for the SCIM & provisioning logs? Please confirm retention windows included in the package and call out any gaps.

Samira — one last Q: do you need the SCIM config (schema/attribute map) included or is the delta alone sufficient for the auditor?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Customer Security Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, ShieldHealth SOC <soc@shieldhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2028 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request — SSO/SCIM/RBAC (mini-collector)

On Fri, Jul 19, 2028 at 10:05 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com> wrote:
> Jonas and Marcus — can you own collection and redaction for the SCIM & provisioning logs? Please confirm retention windows included in the package and call out any gaps.

Will do. Technical notes / what I'll include:
- SCIM delta snippet (CSV): columns: op, externalId (hashed), userName, email (hashed), attribute_changes (JSON blob), timestamp, actor (service account or SCIM bridge id).
- SAML assertions: 4 samples (interactive, passwordless OIDC->SAML bridge, service-account SSO, expired/renewal sample). Assertions will have NameID (hashed) + attributes (email, groups, role_claim).
- RBAC owner matrix: CSV and XLSX, will indicate role_id, role_name, owner_email (hashed), last_changed_by, last_changed_at.
- Provisioning/login log timeslice: we will pull from the auth proxy and include UTC timestamps. I will include a short README describing timezone normalization and the hashing salt used.

Retention windows: our auth logs are retained for 90 days in hot storage and 365 days in cold; SCIM deltas are persisted for 180 days. I'll call that out in the README and include the S3 path references (redacted).

Delivery method: I can upload to the Drive folder Kimberly creates; I'll also drop a copy to our secure SFTP if needed. Confirm which HubSpot deal ID to attach to the ticket so ShieldHealth can reference it with the auditor.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Identity Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Samira Patel <samira@shieldhealth.com>
Cc: ShieldHealth SOC <soc@shieldhealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request — SSO/SCIM/RBAC (mini-collector)

Samira — delivery complete. Attached and linked items below (Drive link shared view-only to soc@shieldhealth.com):

Attachments included:
- scim-delta-snippet.csv — 2-day SCIM delta, hashed externalId/email, op,timestamp,actor.
- saml-assertion-samples.txt — 4 raw assertion examples with comments; NameID/email attributes hashed.
- rbac-owner-matrix.xlsx — current role -> owner snapshot (sensitive columns hashed).
- provisioning-log-timeslice.log — 24-hour window of provisioning/login events (UTC).
- scim-schema.json — attribute map and notes on optional attributes.
- README_access-package.md — describes hashing salt approach, retention windows (SCIM 180d, auth logs hot 90d / cold 365d), data sources, and S3 path placeholders.

Notes on redaction: we hashed user identifiers using HMAC-SHA256 with a salt; the README documents the process and the auditor can validate consistency without seeing raw PII. If the auditor insists on a trusted mapping, we can provide a controlled mapping under an NDA and paper trail.

Delivery links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-example-delivery
HubSpot: attached to deal SH-4821 per your request.

If you need additional day ranges or full exports for a deeper review, flag which artifact to prioritize and we'll schedule an extended pull (note: full exports require ticketed scheduling due to size).

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Customer Security Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
